name: Po Cha (Butter Tea)
ingredients: Strong black tea leaves or brick tea
Yak butter or unsalted churned butter
instructions: 1. Boil a handful of tea leaves in water to create a strong, dark concentrate.
2. Strain the tea liquid into a traditional cylindrical churn (chandong) or a blender.
3. Add a generous knob of yak butter and a pinch of salt to the hot tea.
4. Churn or blend the mixture vigorously until the butter is completely emulsified and the tea becomes thick and frothy.
5. Pour into cups and serve hot, often enjoyed with tsampa (roasted barley flour).
description: Po Cha is a staple beverage in the high-altitude regions of Arunachal Pradesh, particularly among the Monpa and Sherdukpen communities. It is deeply ingrained in the culture, serving as a source of warmth and energy in cold climates, and is traditionally offered to guests as a sign of hospitality.
